result.detail: On the balanced graph the OT-evidence subtype graph leaves TransE at 0.318952/0.305731, down from 0.332411/0.333661, while RotatE rises to 0.345405/0.329201 from 0.337208/0.332994. The gain is therefore family-specific: it helps the relation-aware GNN and the rotational embedding but not the translational one.
